prompts.lineman: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source sheet for a fantasy football game's transparent pixel-art sprite pack. Create ONE coherent adult HUMAN LINEMAN archetype, male, medium brown skin, wearing navy and royal-blue helmet and pads, warm ivory trim, brown leather, steel. Refer to the established Human chibi armor style; plain braced lineman gear. 4 columns x 2 rows of EXACTLY EIGHT isolated cells on a transparent background, equal cell size, generous empty transparent margin and clear gutters. Row 1 left to right: upright FRONT (face visible), upright BACK (back of helmet and armor, face hidden), upright FRONT three-quarter looking toward viewer's right, upright BACK three-quarter looking toward viewer's right (face mostly hidden). Row 2 left to right: upright RIGHT SIDE profile, FACE-UP prone lying on ground, FACE-DOWN stunned lying on ground, separate HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS PORTRAIT of same character. Each full-body figure fully contained in its own cell, feet/hands uncut. All poses show same armor and body; every pose is drawn independently with authentic front/back details, no flips. Adult roughly 3-head chibi proportions. Crisp 2D hand-placed-looking pixel clusters, 1-2 pixel near-black outlines at reduced 64px size, readable big shapes, no gradients or speckles. Top-left lighting. Mirror-safe equipment: no words, no letters, no numbers, no asymmetric symbols. No text, cell dividers, UI, field, grass, floor, shadow, or background. True transparent alpha outside the art.
